meta.title: Nexata | Privacy Policy
meta.description: Learn how Nexata collects, uses, and protects your personal information. We never sell your data to third parties.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.p1_a: Nexata is an enterprise knowledge platform developed by
intro.p1_b: (currently operating as a sole proprietorship in Argentina, with plans to incorporate as an LLC in the United States in the near future).
intro.p2: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal information when you use our services, including our web application, API, and any other means by which you interact with us.
intro.p3: By using Nexata, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.
intro.notice_text: We do not sell your personal data to third parties under any circumstances. Nexata is designed from the ground up with privacy and security as core principles.

scope.title: 2. Scope
scope.item_1: All personal data collected through our website (nexata.app)
scope.item_3: Our API and any integration with external services
scope.item_4: Communications between you and our support team
scope.item_5: Data generated by your use of our features
scope.not_item_1: Information collected by third-party websites or services linked from our platform
scope.not_item_2: Privacy practices of connected service providers (Google, Microsoft, Dropbox, etc.)

data_collected.title: 3. Information We Collect
data_collected.s31_item_1: Email address, full name or display name
data_collected.s31_item_2: Unique user identifier from the provider (Google ID, Microsoft ID, etc.)
data_collected.s31_item_4: OAuth 2.0 access and refresh tokens (stored encrypted)
data_collected.s32_item_1: IP address, browser type and version, operating system
data_collected.s32_item_2: Pages visited, visit time and timestamp
data_collected.s32_item_4: Questions and queries made to Nexy
data_collected.s33_title: 3.3 Information We Derive From Your Data
data_collected.s33_item_1: File Metadata: name, MIME type, size, dates, paths
data_collected.s33_item_2: Content Chunks for efficient processing and contextual retrieval
data_collected.s33_item_3: Vector Embeddings: numerical representations for semantic search (non-reversible)
data_collected.s33_item_4: Extracted Entities and Topics to improve organization and summaries

usage.title: 4. How We Use Your Information
usage.s41_item_1: Authentication and authorization: verify identity and manage access
usage.s41_item_2: Connection and synchronization of external services
usage.s41_item_3: Search and retrieval within your connected files
usage.s41_item_4: Nexy functionality: answer questions based on your files
usage.s42_item_1: Analyze feature usage to make Nexata more useful
usage.s42_item_2: Understand needs to prioritize new features
usage.s42_item_3: Monitor system performance and error rates
usage.s42_item_4: Use anonymized interactions to improve Nexy accuracy
usage.never_label: We never use your information for:
usage.never_item_2: Selling your data to advertisers or data brokers
usage.never_item_3: Creating user profiles for external marketing
usage.never_item_4: Training shared AI models with your specific data

sharing.title: 5. Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.intro: We share your information only in limited circumstances:
sharing.provider_desc: AWS, Google Cloud or Azure for hosting; authentication providers; email services for notifications. All under strict confidentiality agreements.
sharing.connected_desc: We facilitate data exchange between Nexata and external services only per your instructions. We never modify or delete data without your explicit action.
sharing.legal_desc: We may disclose information when required by law, valid judicial process, or to protect the personal safety of our users.
sharing.never_text: we sell your personal data, share file contents with advertisers, or provide access to your embeddings to third parties.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.account_desc: Retained while your account remains active. Upon account deletion, credentials are immediately revoked and metadata deleted within 30 days.
retention.content_desc: Upon disconnecting a service, a 7-day grace period begins. After that, all derived data is securely deleted.
retention.logs_desc: Retained for 18 months for security and troubleshooting, then deleted or anonymized.
retention.history_desc: Stored temporarily (max 24 hours of inactivity). No history is permanently stored associated with your identity.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights:
rights.access_desc: Request a copy of your personal information
rights.erasure_desc: Request deletion of your personal information
rights.portability_desc: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
rights.objection_desc: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
rights.restriction_desc: Limit the use of your information in certain circumstances
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at:

security.title: 8. Data Security
security.rest_desc: AES-256-GCM for all stored personal data, including credentials, metadata, and processed content.
security.transit_desc: TLS 1.2 or higher for all communications between your browser and our servers.
security.access_desc: RBAC and least-privilege principle for all personal and system access. 2FA required for administrative access.
security.monitoring_desc: Complete audit logs, continuous monitoring of suspicious activities, regular vulnerability scans, and penetration testing.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.p1: Nexata is not directed at children under 13. We do not intentionally collect personal information from individuals under that age.
children.p2: If we discover we have collected information from a minor without valid parental consent verification, we will delete it immediately. If you are a parent and believe your child has provided us with information, contact us at privacy@nexata.app.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.intro: We reserve the right to modify this Policy at any time. For significant changes:
changes.item_1: Email notification to your account address
changes.item_2: Prominent notice on the platform upon login
changes.item_3: Clear explanation of what changed and why
changes.item_4: 30-day period to review before taking effect

meta.title: Nexata — AI-Powered Business Assistant
meta.description: Connect your tools, centralize your enterprise knowledge, and get smart answers instantly with Nexata.

hero.title: Your enterprise knowledge, one question away
hero.tagline: Powered by Nexy, your knowledge assistant
hero.subtitle: Connect. Search. Find. A single access point for all your company's knowledge, powered by artificial intelligence.

intro.title: The nexus of your enterprise knowledge
intro.body: Nexata is an enterprise knowledge platform designed to solve the information fragmentation that modern businesses suffer from.
intro.body2: Instead of jumping between Google Drive, Gmail, Dropbox, calendars, and other systems, Nexata unifies all these services into a single intelligent search engine that understands context and delivers precise answers — not just results.
intro.step_1_desc: Link your work sources (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Dropbox) in minutes.
intro.step_2_desc: AI automatically processes and organizes your documents, emails, and events.
intro.step_3_desc: Ask natural questions like 'When did we send the budget to client X?'
intro.step_4_desc: Instant results with full context, exact citations, and direct links.

sources.title: Connectable data sources
sources.subtitle: Connect your favorite tools and start unifying your enterprise knowledge in seconds.

nexy.title: Meet Nexy
nexy.subtitle: The intelligent assistant that speaks the language of your data. While other tools only index files, Nexy understands context, relationships, and meaning.
nexy.feature_1_desc: Find documents by concept, not just exact keywords.
nexy.feature_2_desc: Connect information from emails, files, and events into a unified answer.
nexy.feature_3_desc: Query events, deadlines, and timelines linked to your documentation.
nexy.feature_4_desc: Ask questions in everyday language. Nexy interprets intent, not just commands.
nexy.feature_5_desc: Request summaries, specific data extraction, or version comparisons.

usecases.title: Use cases
usecases.item_1_problem: A sales team needs to quickly find the latest contract modified with a specific client among thousands of files.
usecases.item_1_solution: Search: 'client XYZ contract modified in January'. Get: The exact document with version history. From 20 minutes to 10 seconds.
usecases.item_2_problem: A manager needs to recall what was agreed in an email 3 months ago about a scope change.
usecases.item_2_solution: Search: 'scope change dashboard project February'. Get: The specific email with the complete thread and attachments.
usecases.item_3_problem: A new employee needs to learn processes and documentation without bothering the team.
usecases.item_3_solution: Ask: 'How do I process vendor invoices?' Get: Guides, procedures, and references. Autonomy from day 1.
usecases.item_4_problem: Preparing for a meeting requires manually searching emails, documents, and notes.
usecases.item_4_solution: Search: 'preparation for ABC client meeting tomorrow'. Get: Relevant documents, emails, and previous notes.
usecases.item_5_problem: Audit or compliance documentation needs to be found quickly.
usecases.item_5_solution: Search: 'fiscal documents 2024 or contracts with NDA clause'. Get: Complete listing with advanced filters.

features.title: Key features
features.item_1_desc: Understands natural language queries, not just exact keywords.
features.item_2_desc: Google Drive, Gmail, Google Calendar, Dropbox, Microsoft 365.
features.item_3_desc: Results in seconds, not minutes of browsing through folders.
features.item_4_desc: Every result includes metadata, dates, participants, and direct links.
features.item_5_desc: Access controlled by user-specific permissions and scopes.
features.item_6_desc: Nexy, your assistant that converses with your enterprise knowledge.

why.title: Why choose Nexata?
why.testimonial_1_quote: Before Nexy, searching for information was an expedition. Now it's a conversation.
why.testimonial_2_quote: Nexy connected an 8-month-old email with a current presentation that resolved a contractual conflict. A normal search doesn't do that.
why.testimonial_3_quote: Implementation in minutes, not months. Native connectors without complex configuration. Total permission control.

cta.title: It's not search. It's intelligence.
cta.subtitle: Discover what your company already knows. Connect your first source for free and start finding the information that matters.
